# Camp Resource: Thrasher Field Dressing Station

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Jul 24, 2024
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_a7914e0645ee44adbd4ee6716942351c~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

This Thrasher put up a fight but now you get to eat well!

- Collects Meat over time -

This item cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. ITEMS APPEAR WHILE IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Rad Turkey Field Dressing Station__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d21a1939e6c44b74b0985846f07943e0~mv2.jpg)

**Produces**

Brahmin Meat - 9.09%

Chicken Thigh - 9.09%

Mongrel Dog Meat - 9.09%

Fox Meat - 9.09%

Iguana Bits - 9.09%

Mole Rat Meat - 9.09%

Mutant Hound Meat - 9.09%

Radstag Meat - 9.09%

Radroach Meat - 9.09%

Squirrel Bits - 9.09%

Raw Wolf Meat - 9.09%

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

1 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

None

**Found under X in the camp build menu**

Resources

**Holds**

10 Pounds

**Obtainable via**

Atom Shop - __Thrasher Field Dressing Station__ - 500 atoms

Atom Shop - __C.A.M.P. Resource Bundle__ - 1500 atoms

**Produces X amount per**

Every 10 minutes and 12 seconds

**Meat lasts X minutes in the collector**

135 minutes

**Lockable**

Yes

**Power Required**

No

**Flamingo Units**

6 Flamingo Units

Hi, I'm Kat or Duchess

I'm an Australian data miner who writes farming, event, and food buff guides for Fallout 76.

I believe that all knowledge and information should be free, which is why my guides will never be locked behind a paywall. However, running a website and photo and video editing software does not come cheaply.

So, If you found my guides helpful, please consider buying me a ko-fi (coffee) using the link below.
